notes.title: Almost-10-Year Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
We meet again, People of Earth!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5324722/6e4762093eb0e1523d939ffb4b7d2dc8928072b3.png

Hello!

We're updating the Oozi's adventure to keep it fresh and make sure it's in a healthy state for everyone to enjoy on both Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck devices. Here are the changes we've made:

Improvements & Fixes

 Limited the engine framerate to fix cases of broken game physics (e.g. moving platforms, conveyor belts, bomb-platforms).
 Improvements to Kid difficulty (e.g. bombs/fruits don't expire and you can jump while carrying them, triggering alarms no longer closes doors)
 Boss encounters balance improvements across all the difficulty levels.
 Improved support for Proton compatibility layer (Linux & Steam Deck).
 Fixes for controller vibration function not working.
 Fixes for the Cloud Save progress being reset.
 Fixes regarding crashes & launch errors.
 Other minor fixes & improvements.
In the case that you experience any visual stuttering on higher refresh rate displays, please make sure you are playing the game in the fullscreen mode (set in main menu options).

Switch Version Available Now!

For anyone interested, we've also just ported & launched Oozi for the Nintendo Switch, where it's titled Super Cute Alien's Adventure. Feel free to check it out at My Nintendo Store & watch the new trailer:

[previewyoutube=HcNtubV7nEs;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HcNtubV7nEs[/previewyoutube]
Thank you for all the support you've given us over the past 10 years ːheart_meː

notes.title: Fury Unleashed - Our newest game now available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5324722/295e4d6f14a774335999e37cf77c85ce00488604.png



Hi everyone! After 5 years of work, we've finally released the full version of our newest game - the combo-driven rogue-lite action-platformer - Fury Unleashed!

Thanks to the support of our players over the span of the 3 years-long Early Access period, we've managed to improve the game in every way and shape it into something we are proud of. Thanks to that, we are constantly being given positive reviews, both by the industry critics and from our players.

The game was created by combining inspiration from modern roguelite platformers, like Dead Cells and Rogue Legacy, with nostalgic memories of old-school platformer shooters, like Contra and Metal Slug.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/465200/Fury_Unleashed/


Release Trailer
In the same time as the Early Access graduation, Fury Unleashed was also released on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. Here is our release trailer for the game:

[previewyoutube=XcOnFLxfau8;full][/previewyoutube]


All You Need To Know
Also, if you'd like to learn more about the game, here's a short video that talks about all the important details and should answer the most common questions you might have:  

[previewyoutube=KDBKSxV5mTk;full][/previewyoutube]

 Thank you for your support!

We'd like to remind you, that our studio is composed of just 5 people, so all the feedback and help we keep receiving from our community is appreciated! Feel free to join us on our Awesome Games Studio Discord Server, to chat with us and the rest of the Awesome Community: https://discord.gg/m4JfXuS


Stay awesome!
Awesome Games Studio Team

notes.title: Localization update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
today we've released an update for Oozi: Earth Adventure that adds localization support and adds Poilish and Chinese languages. The game's language can be changed in game's options.
